main.description: A named bundle of permissions assignable to community members.

badge.description: A small badge shown next to the names of members holding this role.

hoisted.description: Whether holders are listed separately in the member list.

mentionable.description: Whether @role mentions resolve to this role.

protected.description: Whether this role is exempt from modification and deletion. Set on the owner role created with the community.

default.description: Whether every member holds this role from the moment they join. Set on the members role created with the community. A default role cannot be deleted.

channelOverride.description: Allow and deny lists scoped to a single channel.

channel.description: The space key of the channel this override applies to.

deny.description: Permissions denied within this channel. Deny beats both the base permissions and allow.

iconBadge.description: A badge drawn from the client's curated icon set.

icon.description: The icon's identifier in the curated set, for example shield-check.

color.description: Hex colour as #rrggbb. Absent means the role colour, or the client's default badge colour when the role has none.

imageBadge.description: A badge drawn from an uploaded image.

image.description: A square image, shown at about 16 pixels.
